headline: JSA advises Mamaearth on ₹135 crore majority stake acquisition in Fluence Pharma
sum: Honasa Consumer Limited, the parent company of Mamaearth, has made an acquisition of a 58% stake in Fluence Pharma Private Limited for ₹135 crore. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Honasa on this stake acquisition.
detail: Honasa Consumer Limited, the parent company of Mamaearth, has made an acquisition of a 58% stake in Fluence Pharma Private Limited for ₹135 crore. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Honasa on this stake acquisition. The transaction was led by Lalit Kumar (Partner) and Amandeep Singh Virk (Partner), with support from Associates Muskaan Gupta, Sameer Dahiya, Rahul Kapoor; and Aditi Sharma. Kumarmanglam Vijay (Partner and Head of Practice, Direct Tax) and Surajkumar Shetty (Partner) advised on Tax law aspects.
